what_became_official.evidence: EV-SEMBIN-c6e9ad -- direction neutral, strength inconclusive, claim_tier toy, proof_status derivation. Scoped to COMMENSURABILITY ONLY, per the contract's interpretation_limits.
what_became_official.why_inconclusive_and_not_refine: The contract's declared primary metric was never computed as an output. `refine` presupposes a measured comparison that needs sharpening; there is none to sharpen, because the instrument for the map has to be built first. `support` fails on unobserved strictness, `reject_scoped` on the bar that forbids resting it on one unreplicated empirical-only run, and replicate/expand because re-running the same instrument pair reproduces the same definitional gap at greater cost.
what_became_official.proof_status_derivation_matters: The finding follows from one binding line in run_cells.py and one docstring in closure_cert.py. It would stand unchanged if every memory-capped cell had completed, which is why it is a derivation rather than an empirical-only result -- and why more compute is not the remedy.

completion_criterion_1_is_NOT_met.the_criterion: GOAL-SEMBIN-5078bc's first completion criterion asks for a committed Coordinator decision stating the map between Semaev's d_F4 and GOAL-DREG-001's Macaulay-rank d_reg/D, instrumented on identical instances, so that campaign's measurements can be read as bearing on Assumption 1 or explicitly as not bearing on it. Either answer satisfies it; an unstated map does not.
three_independent_and_individually_suffi: The instrumented map is d_F4 versus closure_D, not the criterion's map. code/run_cells.py binds the contract metric NAME D_macaulay_rank_statistic to the VALUE closure_D, and closure_D is F4-side by its own docstring definition, so the headline is an agreement between two F4-side quantities.

The instance intersection with GOAL-DREG-001 is EMPTY, so 'instrumented on identical instances' is unsatisfiable from this package. The DREG-side instrument ran on 31 instances and returned a degree on NONE of them.
The narrow map that CAN be stated is argued rather than instrumented, and it was already committed in EV-DREG-008's own boundaries seven weeks earlier.
completion_criterion_1_is_NOT_met.reachable_not_blocked: The criterion is reachable. It is simply no nearer discharged than before this batch, and saying so is the point. An unstated map does not satisfy it and neither does a map between the wrong pair of quantities.

the_hypothesis_does_not_move.record: H-SEMBIN-112e2e stays `specified`. This archive does not touch it.
the_hypothesis_does_not_move.why_the_two_facts_point_opposite_ways: Unobserved strictness reads adverse; an unmeasured quantity reads neutral. The neutral reading wins, and the decisive ground was found late in the composition: the hypothesis states that the predicted separation IS the excluded 'No pairs to reduce' tail -- and that tail is EMPTY in msolve across all 749 F4 rounds. So the hypothesis's own mechanism predicts separation 0 on this engine, and the observed 0 is CONSISTENT WITH it rather than against it.
the_hypothesis_does_not_move.coverage_confirms_no_verdict_was_availab: Across the four cells where strictness is predicted, two produced nothing and four of the five remaining rows are unit-ideal, leaving exactly ONE non-degenerate separation-cell observation.

priors_scored_five_confirmed_two_refuted.the_asymmetry_is_the_finding: Every prior about a DEFECT held. Every prior about what the run ESTABLISHED fell. That pattern is recorded because it is more informative than either half alone.
priors_scored_five_confirmed_two_refuted.P-6_refuted: Leads the scored-priors report. The plan had flagged it THIS_IS_THE_PREDICTION_I_MOST_EXPECT_TO_LOSE and written its escape clause in advance; the clause fired verbatim. The commensurability answer is argued in prose, was already in EV-DREG-008's boundaries seven weeks earlier, and has no shared cell with the target campaign.
priors_scored_five_confirmed_two_refuted.P-7_refuted: `refine` was the Coordinator's prior; `inconclusive` is the answer. All three of P-7's EXCLUSIONS survive and are adopted.
priors_scored_five_confirmed_two_refuted.P-1_through_P-5_confirmed: Byte-identity control reframed -- and worse than predicted, since run_cells.py assigns both hashes from one variable so the run's own check is vacuous; the headline reproduces but on 11 rows not 9; the metric was substituted undeclared; the falsification criterion is unsound; the matched-null conjunct is unevaluable.
priors_scored_five_confirmed_two_refuted.why_this_block_exists: 'Three reviewers concurred' and 'three reviewers concurred with what the Coordinator already believed' are different findings, and only a prior recorded before any reviewer ran separates them. The plan was committed at 43e99599f in a commit containing no reviewer output.

nine_versus_eleven_reconciled: Eleven rows carry both instruments -- 9 distinct structured instances plus 1 known-false control and 1 identity repeat. The decision adopts 9 for the map claim and 11 for separation-bearing rows, and states which is in use wherever either appears. The producer is not wrong to say 9; it is wrong to put 9 in manifest.yaml and 11 in summary.json with no reconciling note.

PD-5, the composition's own overclaim, caught mid-task: an earlier draft stated the declared metric was available at zero run cost on 31 instances. FALSE -- the single-level sweep stops at D = 4, where every structured instance is far from determining (rank 4707 of 12951 columns, deficits 46-67), so obtaining it needs D >= 5, exactly where the memory caps bit. The error made the remedy look cheap and the criterion look nearer, which is the bias this round existed to catch, and it corrects J-2's 'the fix needs zero runs' claim as well.

what_this_archive_does_not_do: It does not move H-SEMBIN-112e2e, which stays `specified`.
It does not discharge GOAL-SEMBIN-5078bc's completion criterion 1, and says so explicitly on all three grounds.

It does not change EXP-SEMBIN-c2c312's status beyond making its analysis official, and it does not invalidate RUN-SEMBIN-b6eb9f -- every reported quantity reproduces and no contract invalidation rule fired.

It asserts nothing about Semaev's Assumption 1 or Assumption 2, about any value of d_reg, about GOAL-DREG-001's conclusions, about any elliptic curve, or about the security of any deployed parameter set. The contract's interpretation_limits forbid all of it in either direction and the reviewers confirmed no leakage.
It claims no transfer to cryptographic n. claim_tier is toy: n <= 21, N <= 60, no correspondence, against a paper conclusion needing n = 409 and 571.
It does not close the round's independence gate, which the checker fails on a schema mismatch and which rests on attestations read by hand.
It promotes nothing to knowledge, for the recorded reason above.
the_one_genuine_positive_result_not_flat: msolve is an independently written F4 with the OPPOSITE field-equation convention to the closure instrument, and the two agreed on 11 byte-identical rows under all four d_F4 conventions computed. That is a real cross-engine, cross-convention test of the closure certificate's ARGUED truncated-Buchberger equivalence, and it could have failed. It is recorded as the round's one earned result. What it is not is the map the completion criterion asks for.
